description: This file defines various enums and classes related to serialization for testing purposes within the Orleans project. It includes enum definitions with the GenerateSerializer attribute, custom exception classes, and a class that tracks serialization and deserialization counters.

classes.name: UnserializableException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating an unserializable exception scenario.

classes.name: Unrecognized
classes.description: A serializable class with two integer properties, marked with GenerateSerializer and Id attributes.

classes.name: ClassWithCustomSerializer
classes.description: A class with integer and string properties that tracks the number of times it has been serialized and deserialized.

methods.name: UnserializableException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a message.

methods.name: ClassWithCustomSerializer
methods.description: Static constructor initializing counters for serialization and deserialization.
